mods.description: Take high resolution screenshots because why not

releases.notes:
GitHub-only beta release.

## What's Changed

- Extended screenshot override support to the standard Minecraft screenshot API
- Screenshots requested by other mods now use Renice Shot capture settings when screenshot override is enabled (#11)
- Added a capture queue to handle multiple screenshot requests
- Each queued capture now keeps its own resolution, format, delay, and HUD settings
- Preserved filenames, output directories, and screenshot notifications supplied by other mods
- Improved capture cleanup and recovery after screenshot failures

**Full Changelog**: [1.1.0+mc26.3...1.2.0-beta.1+mc26.3](https://github.com/wechirok/renice-shot/compare/1.1.0%2Bmc26.3...1.2.0-beta.1%2Bmc26.3)
